show.title: Kadhi Chawal Ka pyaar
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/SWzmA2
show.description: A simple, white-shirted Chawal marries the elite Kadhi, but she betrays him for the wealthy, greasy Kachori. After a bitter legal battle and a brutal beating, Chawal vows to change his "status" and flees to Hyderabad. There, he undergoes a fiery transformation with Chicken and Mutton to become the billionaire king of dishes, Biryani. In the end, he coldly rejects a now-destitute Kadhi, leaving his "fika" past behind to rule the culinary world.
